title: Committed Plant activates the canonical roster and introduction handoff

given.plant: a new active Plant whose creation transaction has committed
given.roster: canonical roster version 1 with exactly eight agents
given.publisher: an AgentIntroductionSink receiving one strict eight-item batch at the FT-007 downstream boundary

then.activation: all eight canonical agents become eligible for future typed invocation without an immediate model call
then.introduction_handoff: one strict deterministic batch containing exactly eight ordered items keyed by plant_id, agent_id, and roster_version
then.sink_result: accepted or identical duplicate means durable true, accepted_count 8, and null reason; rejected means durable false, accepted_count 0, and plant_not_publishable, batch_invalid, or content_conflict; failed means durable false, accepted_count 0, and persistence_failed
then.retry: the same Plant retry produces the same ids and content
then.forbidden: no provider call, MessageEnvelope, raw Plant data, fake durable or visible-chat success, partial batch acceptance, open Plant transaction, rollback claim after commit, or FT-008 storage/projection implementation
